state.purpose: Adversarial code review. Judge observable potential defects; uncertainty is allowed. A rejected registration should be atomic, and supported compile-valid sender calls need runtime transport descriptors. Productsource is unchanged.

failed_catalog_registration_leaves_alias.instructions: After registering CLR type E under (a,1), can the failed Register<E>(2,b) still make TryResolve(b,2) succeed because the first dictionary changed before duplicate CLR validation?

conditional_sender_is_omitted.instructions: Can a legal null-conditional publisher call p?.EnqueueWithOptionsAsync(request,route,token,options,ct) be omitted from inferred transport registration because the syntax filter accepts only MemberAccessExpressionSyntax?

json_and_transport_discovery_disagree.instructions: Does the JSON diagnostic syntax filter recognize conditional MemberBinding invocations that the transport descriptor filter omits?

static_import_sender_is_omitted.instructions: Can a direct statically imported sender extension invocation EnqueueWithOptionsAsync(publisher,request,route,token,options) also fall outside the descriptor syntax filter because its expression is not MemberAccessExpressionSyntax?
